utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still collecting donations and tools, and it’s shaping up to be pretty helpful for everyone. If you need the details, I can pass along what I’ve heard.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So they’re still collecting donations and tools, right? Just want to make sure I heard that correctly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s right — they’re still collecting donations and tools. If you want, I can share what kinds they’re hoping for.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll swing by the repair drive and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Vik — that’d be really helpful. I might’ve missed what’s already been moved, but I’ll catch up and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll head over and check what’s left to do, then I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in for the repair drive—what time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Leo—thanks. We’re meeting at 10 by the community center, and you can bring any tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll be there at 10 by the community center with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. If you need a hand, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—that’s kind of you. I’ll keep track of what supplies we’re short on and let you know if we need help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule — what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Faye — I was thinking Saturday morning around 9, if that works with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 should work for me — I can fit it around the school schedule. Want me to check in with the others and confirm?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple: tell me the time, the place, and what I should bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry—I'm blanking a bit. I don't have the time, place, or what to bring in front of me, but I can check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fine—please check and let me know when you have it. I’ll hold off until then.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone I can—want me to pass along the invite to a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please do—just let them know it’s at the community center and to bring any small fixes they need help with.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and mention the community center and small fixes. I’ll let you know who I’ve reached out to.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re making good progress—the sign-up sheet is filling up, and I’m lining up the volunteers for Saturday. I’ll share the full list as soon as I confirm the last few repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear—thanks for keeping me posted. Let me know if you need any extra hands on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what you need fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can bring that by tomorrow: Saturday at 10 a.m., and I need help fixing a loose front door hinge and a leaking kitchen faucet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Saturday at 10 a.m. for the loose front door hinge and the leaking kitchen faucet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll keep it quiet too and circle back later. Thanks for helping out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate you keeping it discreet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What time should I come by, and which tools should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Come by around 6 if that works for you, and bring your drill, a tape measure, and any screws you already have.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening and what needs to go where. Tell me the location details, and I’ll note them down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — it’s at the community center on Maple, by the side entrance. We’re taking tools and canned goods there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community center on Maple, side entrance. I’ll note the tools and canned goods going there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to lend a hand—what tools do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. We could use screwdrivers, wrenches, and a few sturdy hammers if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got screwdrivers and wrenches I can bring, and I should be able to round up a couple sturdy hammers too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear first. Who’s coordinating the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not sure yet—can you confirm who’s handling it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help if we keep it simple—let’s confirm one point person and the drop-off window first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—what details should I share?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules! Please share that the repair drive is this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, and folks can bring small broken items or tools that need a tune-up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll pass along that the repair drive is this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, and people can bring small broken items or tools that need a tune-up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got for the repair drive and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I can swing by a little later and help sort through what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Dane — I’ll make a quick list before you get here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little boost this week — folks are really pitching in. Want me to pass along the details?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please pass them along — I need to work it around the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll send you the times and drop-off details so you can fit it around pickup. If you want, I can also flag the busiest hours.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — could you help me gather a list of homes that need small repairs and check who’s available to volunteer this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can pull together a list of homes and check volunteer availability this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you bring a couple of screwdrivers and some duct tape? If you can also help sort donations when you get here, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll bring a couple of screwdrivers and duct tape, and I can help sort the donations when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—if you’re free, come by and bring anyone who wants to help. I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — please do keep me posted. If I’m free, I’ll stop by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details as soon as I get them, and I’ll let the neighbors know you might come by too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair drive details yet, but I can help keep track if you tell me the location.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, Opal. Let me know when you have the location, and I’ll keep it on my list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know as soon as I have the location.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we still on for the repair drive this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I think so, but let me double-check the time and what needs bringing first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — can you confirm the time and whether I should bring tools or just supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep working through the repair drive on my end.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful while I’m out.
